review_type: AI-assisted technical verification and automated tests; confirmed team review responsibilities are recorded separately

tested_environment.installation: Isolated virtual environment; Numba installed there, NumPy and Matplotlib inherited from system site-packages

verified_interfaces.nested_grids: Positive integer step counts divide the finest grid exactly; invalid counts and malformed increment arrays are rejected
verified_interfaces.portable_execution: The code directory resolves its package root and supports isolated output directories
verified_interfaces.dependencies: Compatible version ranges are supplied; original production versions and the tested environment are distinguished
verified_interfaces.figure_units: Asset-price and error axes use currency units; density uses inverse currency; time uses years

tests.saved_data_checks: PASS: original production arrays, all 18 non-affine coarse/reference rows and their SE/CIs, both reference-refinement rows, GBM coarse/fine raw statistics, analytic mean biases, and strong fitted slopes
tests.legacy_smoke: PASS: reduced GBM and non-affine runs, verification, table and figure regeneration in a separate temporary directory
tests.packaged_smoke: PASS: code/run_all.py --smoke with supplementary experiments and report-input generation
tests.separate_copy_checks: PASS: code/verify.py --no-write, all 7 unit tests, and code/run_all.py --smoke from an independently copied package outside the repository
tests.full_production_reproduction: PASS: GBM 160000 paths plus 20000 independent-pilot paths; non-affine 100000 paths with references 2048, 4096, 8192; all original production outputs preserved
tests.smoke_limitation: Reduced-path smoke runs validate execution only; their slopes and confidence intervals are not the submitted production evidence

cross_platform_terminal_comparison.interpretation: Floating-point roundoff only; report conclusions and displayed fitted slopes are unchanged

model_checks.gbm: Price-based EM and scalar Milstein, common Brownian increments, exact lognormal oracle, both discrete moments verified by Gaussian quadrature
model_checks.nonaffine: Prescribed parameters, simultaneous old-Y updates, stable logistic evaluation, correlated Gaussian drivers, nested aggregation, positive finite prices, constant-volatility reduction
model_checks.control_variates: Exactly centered Gaussian-tilt controls checked by independent quadrature; regression coefficients fitted on a separate pilot RNG seed
model_checks.weak_error: Signed payoff differences and pointwise Monte Carlo confidence intervals; unresolved non-affine weak slope is not claimed

ownership_record.team_confirmation: The team confirmed the roles and retrospective review contributions recorded in the individual statements
ownership_record.signature_form: Personal signature and date fields; automated tests do not authenticate signatures
ownership_record.git_attribution: Shared-author commits are not reattributed to individual members

scope_limitation: The kernels are deliberately model-specific and parameterized, not a generic swappable drift/diffusion framework. Deterministic RK4/Newton/adaptive-controller checks are not claimed and are replaced by the Direction 4 SDE requirements.
